name: Thug
blurb: Street muscle. Fists and fury, light on tactics.
shortDesc: A thick-necked bruiser in a stained hoodie.
A wiry fighter with taped knuckles and a hard stare.
A heavy-set man blocking the alley like he owns it.
description: He smells of cheap beer and motor oil. Knuckles are scarred; eyes stay on the exits.
Faded team jacket, scuffed boots, a cheap chain that has seen better nights. He rolls his shoulders when he talks.
Someone paid him to be here. He does not care about the why — only the who and how hard.
